Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun in the Solar System.

Earth is the third planet from the Sun.

Earth's atmosphere consists mostly of nitrogen and oxygen.

The Moon orbits Earth at an average distance of 384,400 kilometers.
Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.

Paris is the capital and most populous city of France.

Tokyo is the capital and most populous prefecture of Japan.
Rome is the capital city of Italy.

Cairo is the capital of Egypt.

The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.

Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level.

Water is an inorganic, transparent, tasteless, odorless, and nearly colorless chemical substance.

Ice is the solid state of water.
Steam is the gaseous phase of water.

The Internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks.
The World Wide Web is an information system where documents and other web resources are identified by URLs.
Software consists of computer programs and libraries.
An algorithm is a finite sequence of rigorous instructions.
Programming languages allow developers to write instructions for computers.
Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language.

Memory stores data and programs for immediate use by the central processing unit.
Hard disk drives store digital data on spinning platters.
Solid-state drives use integrated circuit assemblies to store data persistently.

Magnets produce magnetic fields.

Satellites orbit celestial bodies to transmit signals or observe phenomena.

Schools provide learning spaces and environments for teaching students.

Surgery uses operative manual and instrumental techniques to treat pathological conditions.
